meaning: Primary: unchanged sensor-free questions plus current/reference tokens and UI-selected center -> frozen STEP1/STEP2 Fusion -> trained contextual answer logits. Run/Step select input traces, not question wording or labels. STEP3 fits TRAIN readout and selects trained weights on Validation; STEP4 scores actual Test answers and center-swap/off-center behavior. q99/GMM are explicit preserved comparators, never fallback answers. Synthetic paired truth is not equipment fault truth.
